name: POST /api/leads/route-unowned - Zero-orphan sweep over unowned leads
description: Routes every lead that currently has no owner, oldest first, and reports how many were routed and which failed. A bulk command rather than a resource creation, so it answers 200. This is the zero-orphan BACKSTOP, not the normal path: leads are routed automatically at intake by the capture endpoints, and this exists for leads that arrived while routing was impossible - no active user, or the ProjexCloud gateway down - so a transient outage does not leave a permanent hole in the queue. Failures are COLLECTED rather than thrown: one unroutable lead must not stop the rest of the queue being cleared, so the response can report 200 with a non-empty failures array. limit is clamped to 1..500 and defaults to 100. Route registration note: this literal path is mounted BEFORE /:id/route so Express does not treat 'route-unowned' as a lead id. The sweep creates no addressable resource, so captureResponse records the routed COUNT rather than an id - that is the value a dependent test or an alerting job branches on. routing_method is documented in fieldEnums because the sweep is what writes that column on each lead it places. QA: depends on register, login and at least one capture.

errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, or present without a Bearer token
the bearer token fails verification or has expired
